description.value:
Cost 1 Bandwidth

Traits Paradise-Touched, Glimpse

Choose a point within 30 feet. For 1 minute, within a 30-foot radius of that point, difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain do not exist for you and your allies — you move through the area at full Speed. Enemies are unaffected and the terrain is unchanged for them. The area is fixed where you chose it and does not move with you.
